findings.title: Payment txHash is never recorded or checked on the paid routes, so one payment funds unlimited cards
Anti-replay check and insert split by an await, so concurrent identical proofs both pass
x402 proof checks amount and recipient but never the asset code and issuer
Card "issuance" is mocked: createCard returns random card number and CVV with no issuer call, so paying buyers receive non-functional cards
Facilitator settle result never checked; settle retried on timeout without reconciliation
Wallet auth signature covers only the timestamp, so a captured header set can be replayed on any wallet route for 5 minutes
Webhook HMAC secret accepts any non-empty value, including one character
Unpinned dependencies
Facilitator verify and settle pipeline is never called; paid routes never verify payment

findings.title: Caret-range dependencies with no lockfile in the repository
Webhook returns 200 "accepted" for card events but performs no state change
Card ID is 32-bit and create overwrites on collision
addBalance accepts any amount, including negative or NaN
Payment accepted before body and ownership validation, so a buyer is charged and gets a 400 or 404 with no refund
findById returns the stored card object by reference
Treasury address validated by shape only, not Stellar checksum
findings.evidence: src/config/env.ts:6 `.regex(/^G[A-Z2-7]{55}$/, "Must be a valid Stellar public key (G...)");`

findings.title: Facilitator timeout and retry settings are unbounded numbers
Webhook HMAC check throws on a signature of the wrong length, so the request returns 500 instead of 401
Payment proof is used without schema validation, so a proof with no payload causes a TypeError and a 500
Card records held in per-process memory on a serverless deployment
Webhook event marked processed before any handler runs; a failed handler loses the event on retry
Signed webhook bodies are replayable indefinitely; no timestamp check and random dedupe key when the body has no id
Payment repository upserts over existing txHash records and marks any record settled

failing_checks.title: Asset identity and units
failing_checks.reason: The amount is compared as an exact string to the 7-decimal atomic value (toAtomicUsdc, pricing.ts:101), which is correct for the USDC amount. However, the proof's asset is never read or compared to env.STELLAR_USDC_ASSET (the code and issuer), on this path or on the facilitator path (paymentService.

failing_checks.title: Verification of incoming authentication
failing_checks.reason: The payment proof is an incoming signed artifact, and it is not verified. The only checks are JSON field comparisons (x402.ts:66-84). There is no signature check, no facilitator or Horizon confirmation of txHash, no asset or issuer check, and no check that the source account signed the transaction.
